The distance from a point \((x, y, z)\) to each of these planes is given by the absolute value of the corresponding expression inside the absolute value. The sum of these distances is 4, which means the point \((x, y, z)\) lies within a square of side length 2 centered at the origin.

The volume of this square is \(2 \times 2 \times 2 = 8\). Therefore, the volume of the region is \(\boxed{8}\).
